issues.observed: The torso shape is misshapen and not smooth or ovoid as described.
issues.proposed_change: Refine the body to be more of a smooth, plump ovoid shape.
issues.target: Plump oval torso with smooth transitions

issues.observed: The ears are too conical and not integrated smoothly with the head.
issues.proposed_change: Integrate ears more fully with the head to mimic a smooth silhouette.

issues.observed: The snout is not well-defined or narrow, lacking the pronounced forward projection.
issues.proposed_change: Refine the snout to be narrow and project forward prominently.

issues.observed: The bushy tail is incorrectly placed and does not wrap around the front paws.
issues.proposed_change: Adjust the tail's placement and form to curl around the paws correctly.
issues.target: Bushy tail curling around the front paws

issues.observed: The base does not appear flat or recessed properly.
issues.proposed_change: Ensure the base is flat and slightly recessed for stability.
issues.target: Flat, slightly recessed base plane under haunches

issues.observed: Surface lacks smoothness and clear definition of body features.
issues.proposed_change: Enhance surface smoothness and feature transitions to match the stylized look.

summary: The generated geometry shows some foundational work towards the intended stylized fox figurine but requires significant refinement to meet the brief fully. The proportions and features do not closely align with the reference images.
